surface_value: Structural Monitoring Systems Plc (SMS) and its subsidiary Anodyne Electronics Manufacturing Corp (AEM) are engaged in the development and commercialization of CVM™ technology for detecting critical structural cracks on aircraft. They also manufacture and sell avionics products.
